prompts.name: candy
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet for a Halloween Windows desktop overlay app. Create EXACTLY SIX isolated different Halloween sweets in a strict 3-COLUMN by 2-ROW grid on a truly transparent background, landscape 3:2 composition. Every cell represents EXACTLY 16x16 logical pixels, enlarged as sharp nearest-neighbor square pixels; the complete sheet is equivalent to 48x32 logical pixels. Each sweet should occupy approximately 11 to 14 logical pixels, with at least one fully transparent pixel around its edges. Top left: purple and pink twist-wrapped round bonbon, top middle: orange pumpkin-shaped wrapped candy with a tiny jack-o-lantern face, top right: red and cream spiral lollipop with a short stick. Bottom left: triangular white-orange-yellow candy corn, bottom middle: dark chocolate bar partly inside a violet wrapper, bottom right: bright green gummy bear. One object per cell. Same lovely authentic 16x16 pixel-art language as tiny game inventory icons, 5 to 8 discrete colors each, stepped chunky silhouettes, readable one-pixel outlines and simple highlights. Spooky but cute Halloween palette: purple, orange, lime, pink and chocolate. Absolutely NO antialiasing, smooth gradients, glow, shadows, photographic detail, background, grid lines, borders, text, logos or watermarks. All six objects fully separated and entirely visible, no duplicated objects.

prompts.name: spiders
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet for a Halloween Windows desktop overlay app. Create EXACTLY FOUR isolated little Halloween spiders in a strict 2 by 2 grid on a truly transparent background. Each cell is equivalent to EXACTLY 16x16 logical pixels, enlarged with sharp nearest-neighbor giant square pixels; the whole sheet is a strict 32x32 logical pixel grid. All spiders face the viewer with their entire largest body surface visible and their eight legs visible, and each fits within 13 to 14 logical pixels, keeping at least one transparent pixel on every edge. Top left: plump violet spider with lavender leg outlines and pale tiny eyes. Top right: charcoal jumping spider with a pale gray rim, large white pixel eyes, chunky short legs. Bottom left: orange and dark-brown striped garden spider with orange legs and small light eyes. Bottom right: emerald and lime spider with angular green legs and pale eyes. One spider per cell, four clearly different silhouettes and color palettes. Friendly-spooky game sprites, consistent scale, 5 to 8 discrete colors each, hard stepped pixel clusters and clear readable legs. No spiderwebs or threads in this image: the app draws them separately. No antialiasing, smooth gradients, glow, shadow, photorealism, horror gore, background, grid lines, captions, text, logos or watermarks. Genuine transparent background including gutters.
